residual_risks: checkProvidersDefined now computes bitbucketAPITokenComplete before the map loop, so BitBucket provider counting is deterministic. The old code depended on Go map iteration order and could double-count. Only the count==0 check consumes the count, so observable behaviour is unchanged.
Live-provider tests skip without network or tokens, so the refactored backup, schedule and notify paths are only covered by build, vet and the offline tests.
